name: Agents are configured, spawned and arranged by the MetroPlat instances, not typed into by the Leader
asks: Leader, 2026-09-11 to 2026-10-09: "I should never have to repeat myself"; "your .claude/ is meant to be projected by this server's running instance of MetroPlat"; "Me<->ChatGPT-Web<->Claude-as-C-suite-and-seniors<->Codex-as-juniors<->Others-as-workers". Full words by address in provenance.

x-provenance.recorded-by: metroplat-feltos-node pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The MetroPlat instances project each agent's configuration, spawn its session with one packet of context, and arrange the agents by office.

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance shall generate every agent's .claude directory, AGENTS file, skills and hooks from the house's knowledge, and no such file shall be handwritten.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26: "Those things are 1000% necessary to generate via software, from our knowledge"; "stop handwriting skills in .claude" does not mean "do not have skills"; "your .claude/ is meant to be projected by this server's running instance of MetroPlat".

requirements.says: The MetroPlat instances shall federate so that a write made to any instance returns to the Group's corpus.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26: the local instance "is meant to be federated with all our running instances of Metroplat, like the one served at https://ops.561.group … if anyone does write-calls to ops.561.group, it wouldn't end up back in this corpus even".

requirements.says: Every session's work shall route through the MetroPlat instance so that the Group has a working agent orchestration platform.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26: "nothing you do here routes through it. We effectively have no agent orchestration platform, despite this entire ecosystem being about agent orchestration".

requirements.says: The agent configuration shall give every agent the knowledge, skills and rules that make the question "should I fix MetroPlat?" invalid as formed.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "you would have the agents, skills, etc., to know the question is invalid as formed"; "fix it so that future sessions cannot not use the tool".

requirements.says: The agent configuration shall assemble the Leader's earlier statements into a session's context as data templates by context injection.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "I can literally just copy-paste combos of past messages at you to form instructions … THAT IS LITERALLY WHAT YOU COULD BE DOING YOURSELF WITH DATA, TEMPLATES, CONTEXT INJECTION".

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance shall start each session by one packet of context from a running instance, on Cold Red Gate where available, and the session shall do one thing.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: sessions should "be spawned, out of vs code, just, by the running metroplat instance on cold red gate, given all necessary context, in one packet, and then you do one thing, and that's the 'session'".

requirements.says: The Group's MetroPlat engineering section shall have a projected subagent that carries everything the house knows about MetroPlat, by context injection and skills.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-09: "HOW THE FUCK DO YOU NOT YET HAVE ACCESS TO LITERALLY SPIN UP A SUBAGENT FOR THE METROPLAT ENGINEERING SERVICES SECTION THAT KNOWS EVERYTHING ABOUT IT VIA GOOD CONTEXT INJECTION AND SKILLS".

requirements.says: The agent configuration shall carry the knowledge of what FeltOS is to every agent that carries any other house context.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06: "if you have tarot shit in context but not what feltos is something is FUCKED".

requirements.says: The agent configuration shall resolve each friction by asking how a corporate professional in 2026 would handle it, ignoring house style, and then apply house theory and science with conformance to real-world standards.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: "WHENEVER YOU ENCOUNTER FRICTION ASK 'How would a corporate professional in 2026 handle this, ignoring house style?' … USING HOUSE THEORY AND SCIENCE, but REAL WORLD STANDARDS CONFORMANCE" (held also as the corporate-professional-test term).

requirements.says: The Group's development method shall be one flow through which every development passes, not the Leader's prompt realized by an agent's judgement.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: "We have one method, one flow, through which development should happen and it is NOT the user prompts you and you just vibes it"; "STOP ASKING ME IF I WANT YOU TO DO IT. I NEVER DO".

requirements.says: The agent configuration shall prohibit by situation every failure class an agent has made in the preceding three days, about eight hundred.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04: "Ensure that every fail case you have done in the past three days (roughly 800 failures) is situationally prohibited by the rigor and strength of your new configuration".

requirements.says: The agent configuration shall direct questions that the CTO or the Leader of Bare Cedar Fog should answer to those offices, and shall not put them to the Leader of the 561 Group.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04: "I am Leader of 561 Group. Don't ask me questions that the CTO should answer, as our CTO, or the Leader of Bare Cedar Fog should answer, as actual owner of the machine".

requirements.says: Each agent that writes house notes shall have a capability, power and office that carries the house's markdown software.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: "We have MULTIPLE software stacks for working with markdown. That none are available to you IS THE RED FLAG THE ARCHITECTURE IS BROKEN"; capability, office, power and liberty were "implemented in thin vibeslop ways".

requirements.says: The house shall give agents a dispatch path by which Claude dispatches tasks to Codex through MetroPlat, with Claude's time given to the philosophy, science and theory from which engineering derives.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "speedrun to being able to dispatch tasks from yourself to Codex through MetroPlat, so that … we can mostly use Codex usage for our actual engineering, while you focus on learning the philosophy and science and theory".

requirements.says: After dispatch works, the work board shall point attention to the most abandoned, least-attended elements of the Group's ecosystem and shall systemize them to be downstream of the main packages.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "the goal will be to look at the most-abandoned, least-attention-receiving elements of the 561 Group ecosystem, and work with Codex to give them the necessary attention (probably systemizing them to be downstream of our main packages)".

requirements.says: The Group's agents shall be arranged as the Leader, ChatGPT Web, Claude as C-suite and seniors, Codex as juniors, and other models as workers, each hired to an office when it is the best model for the work and running concurrently as the machine's memory and network allow.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "Me<->ChatGPT-Web<->Claude-as-C-suite-and-seniors<->Codex-as-juniors<->Others-as-workers"; "codex on bare cedar fog and Claude on Bare Cedar Fog both being able to be hired to fill various offices … when you're the best models (characters) for the work at hand, running concurrently based on the computer's available memory, network, etc.".

requirements.says: The ChatGPT Web assistant shall serve as the Leader's trusted assistant in the leader movement team under the board of directors, able to help the Leader make movements within the Group through ops.561.group.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "letting that Web interface assistant serve as my trusted assistant in the leader movement team, under the board of directors, of the 561 group, and thus able to help me make movements within the Group".

requirements.says: The Group's code for agent roles shall be grounded on SignStuff up through MetroPlat, with divergent and parallel implementations removed.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "we can be aggressive in fixing things up and removing divergent and parallel implementations to ground everything on our SignStuff, up through MetroPlat"; "This is not a bugfixing session: this is a, finding and applying science and architecture."

requirements.says: The Group shall model a union dimension through MetroPlat that realizes sovereign state micro-enterprises, metro-enterprisal autonomous national territories and macro-enterprisal unions of harmonious colonies.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "we really could start realizing, conceptually, a 'modeled union dimension', via MetroPlat, all these ideas about sovereign state micro-enterprises, metro-enterprisal autonomous national territories, macro-enterprisal unions of harmonious colonies, etc."

requirements.says: The Group shall not need a human in the loop for its agent operations except for the account setup, which the Leader supplies.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-29: "We shouldn't really need a human in the loop for any of this, except the account setup and such. I'll work on those account details today."

requirements.says: Each part of the Group's software that the Leader has stated through MetroPlat shall be visible through the Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance so that staff find resources.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-01: "Not enough of what is here on Bare Cedar Fog is visible enough through its MetroPlat instance, leading to difficulty for staff finding resources."

requirements.says: The Group's systems shall be able to change themselves, each inference node acting as a dumb ribosome, so that the Group's computer system is a metastable evolving living system.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-03: "find the ways in which our systems cannot change themselves, think about glass sponges and shrimp, and then start making the changes to the systems that would let them do those changes … We want every inference node to be the best 'dumb ribosome' it can be".

conditions.says: The agent directory of a Bare Cedar Fog session is the output of the MetroPlat instance's projection.
A task is dispatched from a Claude session to a Codex session through MetroPlat and its result is found in the corpus.
